title: Create Credit Term stays disabled until name and number are valid
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, working in {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Starting screen: the Credit Terms page (Settings, then "Credit Terms" in the Finance group) is open on the Active tab.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click "New Credit Term".
  2. Type "Net 9" in Name.
  3. Type 9 in the Days box.
  4. Clear the Name.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the "New Credit Term" window opens.
  • Step 2: "Create Credit Term" is still disabled (no number yet).
  • Step 3: "Create Credit Term" becomes enabled.
  • Step 4: "Create Credit Term" is disabled again.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11672 (Story 3, Create or edit a credit term)

  • S3-R6: “"Create Credit Term" / "Save Changes" stays disabled until the Name and the chosen box are both valid.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Default Credit Terms" (https://claude.ai/artifact/2erYxWz2ffDNcoXzEfu6wf), read 23 Oct 2026: page "3 New credit term and Inactive tab" ("Validation errors"). Compare the screen with the pictures below; the expected results above come from the PRD quotes.

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • ct-p3-03-validation-errors.png

The design's own words:

  • “Create Credit Term stays disabled until every field is valid. Errors show only after a field is touched or Create is pressed; the Name field is never red when the window opens.”
